facts.fact: Echo Namibia and Oblixx Communication Networks secured operating licences following CRAN approvals earlier in 2026 to deliver Q-KON's Twoobii-OneWeb LEO satellite service in Namibia; the exact date is not given.

Eutelsat OneWeb LEO satellite services, branded Twoobii-OneWeb by Q-KON, launched commercially in Namibia on 19 June 2026 through licensed partners Echo Namibia and Oblixx Communication Networks, aimed at businesses, with up to 100 Mbps and 2TB per site.

systems.owner: Q-KON; resold by Echo Namibia and Oblixx Communication Networks
